name: seecode
description: Animated, explorable editorial diagrams in 44 types — architecture, flowchart, sequence, state, ER, DB schema, UML, swimlane, timeline, Gantt, journey, tree, Venn, quadrant, fishbone, Wardley, bar, line, scatter, Sankey, treemap, heatmap, isometric plans, exploded views and more — from a short JSON spec. Hover traces, click-to-focus, route journeys; exports SVG, PNG, GIF, MP4; imports Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw.io, Excalidraw, SQL and CSV.

interface.longDescription: SeeCode turns a description of your system, process, codebase or data into an editorial diagram you can explore: hover to watch data flow, click to zoom into a node, walk a route step by step. You describe it; the agent writes a short spec and SeeCode handles layout, routing, styling, motion and export — interactive HTML for explaining, SVG for docs and PDFs, GIF and MP4 for sharing. It also redraws Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw.io, Excalidraw, SQL and CSV.
defaultPrompt: Use SeeCode to show how our checkout flow works.
Diagram this repository's architecture with SeeCode.
